Problem Statement
Write a program to calculate the electricity bill for a household based on the number of units consumed.
Description
Read the number of electricity units consumed and calculate the bill using the following rates:
First 100 units → ₹2 per unit
Next 100 units → ₹3 per unit
Remaining units → ₹5 per unit
Additionally calculate:
Total Bill Amount
Average Cost Per Unit
Number of Units Above 200
Display the results in the specified format.
Sample Input
250

Total Bill: 850
Average Cost Per Unit: 3
Units Above 200: 50
